mapper.select: SELECT id, config_key, version, horizon_days, horizon_segments, source, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM mkt_industry_application_config WHERE config_key = #{configKey} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mkt_industry_application_config ( id, config_key, version, horizon_days, horizon_segments, source, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{value.id}, #{value.configKey}, #{value.version}, #{value.horizonDays}, #{value.horizonSegments}, #{value.source}, #{value.remark}, COALESCE(#{value.createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{value.updatedAt}, now()), NULL ) ON CONFLICT (config_key) DO UPDATE SET version = EXCLUDED.version, horizon_days = EXCLUDED.horizon_days, horizon_segments = EXCLUDED.horizon_segments, source = EXCLUDED.source, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, updated_at = now(), deleted_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, target_key, target_type, symbol, name, enabled, interval_minutes, tags, display_order, source, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM mkt_industry_application_target WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY display_order ASC, target_key ASC

mapper.update: UPDATE mkt_industry_application_target SET deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
